models.modelDescription: Cloudflare推出的Clef决策模型，主要用于特定的决策分析任务。该模型配备了专门的评估排行榜，旨在通过Cloudflare的Workers AI平台提供高效的决策支持能力，适用于需要快速、自动化判断及指标分析的应用场景。
models.sourceDescription: - Announcement: Clef decision models on the Cloudflare blog - Decision Index leaderboard: clef-evals.workers-ai-mle.workers.dev
models.author: Cloudflare

models.modelDescription: 该模型是Qwen-Image-2.1的GGUF量化版本，专门用于本地环境下的图像生成。通过保留原始上游基础权重，用户可在个人设备上运行该模型进行创作。由于移除了内容过滤限制，它更适合在本地进行不受限的视觉内容生成任务。
models.sourceDescription: GGUF quantizations of Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1 for local image generation using the original upstream base weights.
models.author: abenzerps

models.modelDescription: Laya是一款多语言、非自回归的系统1决策模型。它通过单次前向传播提供带有数学校准概率的回答，支持超过100种语言。该模型不生成文本，而是输出结构化数据，通过RLCD训练确保概率输出的真实性，非常适合高精度的决策自动化场景。
models.sourceDescription: Multilingual, non-autoregressive System 1 decision model. Give it a state (text, email, ticket, or JSON) and typed questions ; it returns typed answers with mathematically calibrated probabilities in a single forward pass ( 33 ms) across 100+ languages. Trained with reinforcement learning against strictly proper scoring rules ( RLCD ), so reporting honest probabilities is the only way to maximise reward. It never generates text, so there is nothing to parse and nothing to hallucinate.
models.author: convaiinnovations

models.modelDescription: Kolibri-1是Aleph Alpha推出的混合专家（MoE）推理模型，重点优化了德语和英语的表现。该模型支持显式推理模式和工具调用，在保持长上下文处理能力的同时，通过架构优化实现了极高的推理效率，适用于企业级的复杂逻辑分析任务。
models.sourceDescription: Kolibri is Aleph Alpha's mixture-of-experts (MoE) reasoning model, with a focus on German and English. The model supports an explicit reasoning mode and tool calling. It is optimized for long-context and inference efficiency.
models.author: Aleph-Alpha

models.modelDescription: JEV-27B-VL是一款具备视觉理解能力的决策模型，基于JEV架构构建。它整合了系统1的快速决策和系统2的复杂推理能力，并扩展到图像输入处理。该模型旨在通过视觉辅助提高自动化决策的准确性，适用于需要多模态分析的决策支持系统。
models.sourceDescription: JEV-27B that can see: the same System 1 decisions and System 2, now on images
models.author: autotrust
